# dbs-resonate: draft resonance diagnosis

Curated by Skill Harbor — a short pointer to @dontbesilent2025's dbs-resonate skill: diagnose where a finished draft fails to hit its target audience — extract the claims, isolate the single core claim and the expected audience action, pick one dominant communication theory (identity, emotion appraisal, framing, uses-and-gratifications, sharing psychology) grounded in cited research, rate each mechanism as working/weak/ineffective against the actual text, then deliver concrete delete/compress/strengthen edits down to the sentence level with clear out-of-scope boundaries (no traffic predictions, no virality promises). Honest caveats: **no license declared in the repository — license unknown**, so this is a short fiche linking to the source, without reusing its content; the skill is written for Chinese-speaking users and answers in the user's language (Chinese or English); it is rigorous about theory discipline — one main theory per diagnosis, conditional theories only with explicit triggers. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
